assets.name: task_loyly_kiuas_wide

refs.role: identity reference from the concept: match this round dark sauna stove with its heap of stones

layout reference only, the current in-game asset that this image replaces. Match its footprint, aspect and placement of parts (the stove body with a small firebox door low on its left half). Ignore its style, colours and rendering entirely.

style reference, an approved concept plate. Take only the rendering: soft matte shapes, smooth gradients, fine felt texture on snow and cloth, laminated birch edges and the palette. Do not copy its composition, sky, landscape, characters or night lighting.

assets.prompt:
Create a new image using the reference images as described.

ASSET: One sprite: the sauna stove (kiuas) for a task that opens in an arch window (the Opening) in a calm, wordless 2D side-scrolling mobile game set in kaamos, the Finnish blue polar night. It is cut out on a fully transparent background and placed over a painted landscape in code.

SUBJECT: A wide, low, rounded-rectangle matte dark iron sauna stove, its whole silhouette including the stone heap about one and a half times as wide as it is tall, in fjord #0E1A2E and kaamos blue, seen from the side, with a heap of rounded dark granite stones on top, and a small closed firebox door low on its left half at about one third of its width and 60 percent of its height; the door is dark and closed (the game draws the embers). Two thin laminated birch ply bands wrap the stove body.

FRAMING: Full stove filling about 92 percent of the image width and about 85 percent of the image height, centred, nothing cropped, no floor. The overall silhouette is clearly wider than tall, like a low chest, never a tall drum.

RENDERING: Premium flat 2D game illustration, the look of the approved key art, never a 3D render or a toy: strict orthographic side view with no perspective. Large simple shapes with clean, smooth, soft-edged silhouettes and no outlines. Every surface is flat matte colour with exactly one soft, wide gradient that models its form: lighter where a soft neutral light from the upper left reaches, deepening smoothly into a cool kaamos-blue #1E3150 shadow side. Wherever a landform, roof, shelf or object has a cut edge, that edge is laminated like bent birch plywood: two to four thin, even, parallel layers that follow the curve exactly. A very fine, even felt-like micro-texture is allowed on cloth, wool and snow only, barely visible. Feels like matte felt, painted plaster and bent birch plywood, designed with the restraint of Nordic functionalist design.

LIGHT AND COLOUR: Local colours at middle value under soft neutral overcast light. No cast shadow, no glow, no rim light, no light source of any kind, no lit windows, no fire, no night, sunset or warm tint: the game adds darkness, glow and colour grading in code. Use only these colours: birch white #F2EEE6, birch ply #E2C79C, ply edge #B48E5C, kaamos blue #1E3150, fjord #0E1A2E, frost #9DB9CC, lilac haze #B4A6CE, ice #8FC6E0, spring green #9DBE8C, spruce #2F4A48, granite #8A8F9C, ceiling green #C8D6BE.

AVOID: 3D render, clay, plush toy, vinyl figure, glossy or plastic highlights, specular shine, metallic reflections, hard cel shading, outlines or black strokes, brush strokes, watercolour blooms, paper grain on the background, photorealism, any face or eyes, any person other than the Keeper, red, orange-red, orange, pink, coral, magenta, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, signature, frame, border, checkerboard pattern, background scenery, drop shadow.
